companyDescription: Space infrastructure + tactical UAS · Penguin/Stalker drones for NATO/US military + on-orbit space components · $498M backlog, Q2 2026 earnings Aug 5 — the print that decides whether the turnaround thesis holds
priceNote: Self-fetched Aug 4 (no live-prices.json cache yet). Closed Mon Aug 3 at $9.63, +11.72% on a sector-wide defense-tech/drone rally (DoW Office of Strategic Capital loan to PDW Holdings + easing Middle East tensions shifting focus to domestic drone modernization) plus pre-earnings positioning. Still down ~35% over the past 12 months and well off the $26.64 52-week high after two prior earnings misses and dilution.
summary: Redwire reports Q2 2026 earnings after the close on Wed Aug 5, 2026 (call Thu Aug 6, 9am ET) — the highest-stakes print yet after two consecutive misses, most recently a -10.5% drop on the Q1 2026 miss (EPS -166% surprise), plus dilution that dragged the stock from its $26.64 high to under $5 before this year's partial recovery. The setup has real substance behind it: a Taiwan Coast Guard Penguin Mk2.5 win (late Jun/early Jul), $21.5M in fresh Marine Corps Stalker follow-on orders (mid-Jul), a 164,000 sq-ft Huntsville, AL capacity expansion announced for UAS/space production, and a record $498M backlog at a 1.92x book-to-bill. Shares just popped 11.7% Monday on a sector-wide defense-tech rally plus pre-earnings positioning. 9 analysts average a $14.88 target (+58% from here, Moderate Buy), with a $24 street-high. This is a binary, pre-earnings speculative bet: if the backlog converts into revenue/EBITDA, the beaten-down turnaround thesis gets confirmed; a third consecutive miss likely breaks it.

catalysts.name: Q2 2026 Earnings
catalysts.description: Redwire reports after market close Wed, Aug 5, 2026, with the management call Thu, Aug 6 at 9am ET. After two consecutive misses (Q1 2026: -10.5% same-day drop, EPS -166% surprise), this print needs to show the $498M backlog and this year's contract wins converting into revenue and a credible path to positive EBITDA — not just more headline contracts.

catalysts.name: Defense-Tech Sector Tailwind / Federal Drone Funding
catalysts.description: U.S. Department of War's Office of Strategic Capital granted a conditional loan commitment to PDW Holdings — read across the sector as government support for domestic drone/defense manufacturers — while easing Middle East tensions are shifting investor focus from geopolitical risk to long-term modernization spend. Drove Monday's sector-wide rally that lifted RDW 11.7%.

catalysts.name: Huntsville, AL Manufacturing Expansion
catalysts.description: Redwire is adding 164,000 sq ft to its Huntsville campus to expand UAS (Stalker, Octopus gimbal payloads) and space-systems production capacity, backed by ~$8.5M in state/local incentives and ~150 new high-skilled jobs. Construction is underway; campus operational by Q4 2027 — a demand-confidence signal even though the payoff is multi-year out.

risks: Two consecutive earnings misses (most recently -10.5% same-day on the Q1 2026 print) plus dilution are why this stock trades near $9.63 instead of near its $26.64 high — the Aug 5 print carries real credibility risk, not a clean slate
RDW is still unprofitable at scale: -$343.9M TTM net income and -$2.29 EPS — the market needs to see a credible path to positive EBITDA, not just backlog headlines, to sustain this year's recovery
Beta of 3.02 means both the recent 11.7% pop and any post-earnings reaction will be amplified versus the broader market — this is a high-volatility, binary event
Government contract delays and funding-cycle timing remain a live risk even with a $498M backlog — award and delivery timing can slip on either side of a fiscal year

Broader 2026 space-sector rotation risk: capital has moved in and out of names like RDW/ASTS/RKLB around SpaceX's IPO and macro headlines — sector-wide risk-off can drag RDW down even without company-specific bad news
Fed is on hold but hawkish (3 dissents favoring a hike at the Jul 28-29 FOMC) — any surprise hawkish pivot before the next Sept meeting would pressure high-beta, unprofitable small-caps like RDW

estimateDates.note: Third print since the two prior misses; needs to show the $498M backlog converting into revenue/EBITDA, not just more contract wins
estimateDates.est: Consensus in-line expected, a clean beat needed to confirm the turnaround

analystTargets.note: Implied if Redwire executes on the long-term backlog/expansion strategy
Reflects lingering execution risk after two prior misses

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed held at 3.50–3.75% at the Jul 28-29, 2026 FOMC meeting, with 3 dissents favoring a hike — the most dissents since 2016. Chair Warsh's committee signaled a wait-and-see stance until the Sept meeting, when it will have July and August CPI in hand.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Core inflation remains above the Fed's 2% target; markets have shifted from pricing 2026 rate cuts to pricing possible hikes later this year — a headwind for a still-unprofitable small/mid-cap like Redwire (-$343.9M TTM net income).
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Government/defense UAS and space-infrastructure demand is largely macro-independent, but RDW's balance sheet (net losses, prior dilution, credit-line dependence, beta of 3.02) makes it far more exposed to a broad risk-off shock than a self-funded defense prime.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — the next FOMC decision isn't until September, so the Aug 5 print trades mostly on its own merits, but a high-beta, unprofitable small-cap remains more exposed than most to any broad risk-off shift around the print.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Space/defense-infrastructure names in this cohort move on same-day contract-award and sector-tailwind headlines rather than a sustained pre-event grind — RDW's own 11.7% Monday pop (defense-funding + de-escalation news) fired the trading day before the print, echoing the pattern from its Jul 21 Stalker-order pop.
catalystSpot.preRunupTiming: 1-2 days pre-earnings on sector-wide tailwind / contract-pipeline optimism, not a multi-week runup

postWin.note: Rocket Lab jumped 12% on its $8B Iridium takeover (Jun 29, 2026); AST SpaceMobile jumped 12% on Trump's $1.2T Golden Dome estimates (Jul 22, 2026); Redwire's own Stalker follow-on order news drove a +9.5% pop on Jul 21, 2026 — this cohort rewards confirmed contract/beat news with same-day double-digit moves.

postLose.note: Redwire's own Q1 2026 print is the direct precedent: sales missed estimates and EPS surprise was -166.67%, sending the stock down 10.5% same-day; this followed an earlier miss + dilution overhang that had already pulled shares from $26.64 toward single digits. Sector capital also rotated away from names like SPCX (-23% YTD at points) during SpaceX's IPO.

spotSizing.reason: Small/mid-cap ($2.29B), pre-earnings pop already prices in some optimism, and two prior misses are on the record — 4% keeps real upside exposure without over-sizing into the highest-stakes print yet.

th.summary: Redwire รายงานผล Q2 2026 หลังตลาดปิดวันพุธที่ 5 ส.ค. 2026 (conference call พฤหัสที่ 6 ส.ค. 9 โมงเช้า ET) — ผลประกอบการที่มีเดิมพันสูงสุดหลังพลาดเป้า 2 ไตรมาสติด ล่าสุดร่วง 10.5% วันเดียวจากผล Q1 2026 (EPS พลาดเป้า -166%) บวก dilution ที่ฉุดหุ้นจากจุดสูงสุด $26.64 ลงมาต่ำกว่า $5 ก่อนจะฟื้นบางส่วนปีนี้ เนื้อในมีของจริง: ชนะสัญญา Penguin Mk2.5 จาก Taiwan Coast Guard (ปลายมิ.ย./ต้นก.ค.) ยอดสั่ง Stalker เพิ่ม $21.5M จากนาวิกโยธินสหรัฐฯ (กลางก.ค.) ขยายโรงงาน Huntsville รัฐ Alabama 164,000 ตร.ฟุต และ backlog สถิติ $498M ที่ book-to-bill 1.92x หุ้นเพิ่งเด้ง 11.7% วันจันทร์จากกระแส defense-tech ทั้ง sector บวกการเก็งกำไรก่อนประกาศผล นักวิเคราะห์ 9 คนให้เป้าเฉลี่ย $14.88 (+58% จากราคานี้ เรตติ้ง Moderate Buy) เป้าสูงสุด $24 นี่คือเดิมพันแบบ binary ก่อนประกาศผล — ถ้า backlog แปลงเป็นรายได้/EBITDA จริง thesis turnaround จะได้รับการยืนยัน แต่ถ้าพลาดเป้าเป็นครั้งที่ 3 thesis น่าจะพัง
th.priceNote: ปิดวันจันทร์ที่ 3 ส.ค. ที่ $9.63 ขึ้น 11.72% จากกระแส defense-tech/drone ทั้ง sector (เงินกู้จาก DoW Office of Strategic Capital ให้ PDW Holdings + ความตึงเครียดตะวันออกกลางคลี่คลายทำให้ตลาดหันมาโฟกัส modernization ในประเทศ) บวกการเก็งกำไรก่อนประกาศผล ยังลดลงราว 35% ในรอบ 12 เดือน และห่างจาก 52-week high ($26.64) มากหลังพลาดเป้าผลประกอบการ 2 ครั้งและ dilution
